Companion Animal Travel Desk: reptile and rabbit travel notes

Travel records for Aurelia Skyways must stay clear, complete, and current. This note helps travelers prepare animal paperwork, crate checks, and desk review without delay. Keep every item ready before arrival, since the service treats each journey as a shared responsibility.

For reptile travel, bring the animal only after you have reviewed the current desk record and carrier rules. <<FACT F060>> Keep the container secure, dry, and closed for the full trip. The animal must remain under control at all times, and the traveler should keep the paperwork with the crate for inspection.

For rabbit travel, pack the pet and crate together in a way that allows safe handling and steady ventilation. <<FACT F064>> Do not add loose items that can shift during movement, and do not use a damaged carrier. Staff may refuse acceptance if the crate is unsafe, the record is incomplete, or the animal does not match the papers presented at check in.

If a pet is traveling with other baggage, place the kennel where it will not be crushed or tilted. The traveler should arrive early enough to allow the desk to inspect the crate, confirm the details, and enter the service change into the ledger. If Baxter or any other pet is not ready for review, the journey can be delayed until the record is corrected.

Keep food, water, and cleaning supplies separate from the animal space unless the desk gives different guidance. Handle the pet calmly, and avoid opening the crate near doors, crowds, or moving baggage. Each traveler is responsible for following the desk instructions from start to finish, and the staff will document any exception in the service record.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk through the Aurelia Skyways service desk before you travel.
